title: Colored Lights (RPLE) Vanilla Style Lamps
description: A simple resource pack that makes colored lamps from the Colored Lights (RPLE) mod look like vanilla redstone lamps
body:
Colored Lights (RPLE) Vanilla Style Lamps is a resource pack that replaces the textures in Colored Lights (RPLE) to look like colored versions of vanilla redstone lamps.

This resource pack does not change vanilla textures.

you can download the mod that this resource pack applies to here [link](https://modrinth.com/project/glC7saXJ)
